readerCopy.body: Someone else's confidence can become especially irritating when it resembles a kind of visibility another person once learned to suppress. When the Sun opposes Chiron, identity and sensitivity face each other directly, making another person's ease around recognition, leadership, or self-expression bring old comparison into the present. Irritation does not require admiration of the person displaying the trait. It can still reveal a form of permission that was distributed unevenly.
